title: Purple GUI
description: Makes your buttons and minecraft title Purple 💜
body:
# The Purple GUI Resource Pack for Minecraft: Java Edition
This Resource Pack transforms your old fashioned white
GUI buttons to Purple color 💜
Making those buttons more attractive and good looking.

## Compatibility
Java Edition
Version: 1.21.X

## Requirements
No Requirements, compatable with every mod and resource pack
just give it a higher priority in resource pack menu so that
you will see the purple buttons 💜.
